finding.title: Drag evidence shows app was not frontmost before input
finding.message: The 'quiet' drag artifact reports frontmost=false before input was posted, while the README describes it as a success 'with foreground retained'. Foreground was not retained before the drag; it was only true afterward. This weakens the claim and is inconsistent with the other artifacts, which show frontmost=true.
finding.suggestion: Correct the README wording to match the artifact, or rerun the drag with the app confirmed frontmost beforehand and replace the artifact.

finding.message: The zoom evidence file shows status_before and status_after both at zoom 100% with no change, yet the README claims wheel zoom changed the toolbar to 94%. The retained artifact does not support the claim; the 94% value is only visible indirectly in the saved drawing's zoom field. Acceptance evidence that contradicts its own narrative undermines the report.
finding.suggestion: Capture the toolbar zoom value in the evidence (a post-zoom toolbar readout), or reword the README to say the 94% value comes from the saved drawing rather than from this artifact.
